name: Songs of the Broken Crowns
detailed_description:
A strategic, hero-centric collectible card game. Choose your hero. Build your deck. Command the board.

Songs of the Broken Crowns is a game in active development by a small indie team — a high-stakes fantasy card battler where every match is a duel of skill and strategy.

Outmaneuver your rival, make every move count, and turn the tide in your favor.

Victory is earned. Every turn matters.

At its heart, Songs of the Broken Crowns is a return to what made card games special: simple rules, deep strategy, meaningful interaction, and a respect for your time and skill.
No card rarities, no loot boxes. Just a fair, competitive system built around you.

At Cast n Play, we've spent years building fantasy worlds — and now we're channeling that same passion into a card game designed to last.

What is Broken Crowns?
It’s an online 1v1 strategy card game where you build your deck around a hero — each with their own class abilities, weapons, and armor that shape your strategy.
Whether you prefer a control-heavy wizard, an aggressive berserker, or a clever trickster, your choices define your playstyle.

Every card counts. Every decision matters.
Matches are tight, interactive, and built on skill — not randomness. We’ve designed every mechanic to reward thoughtful play, not who spent the most money.

Core Features

  • 100+ Core Cards at Launch: Build decks from a rich and balanced starting set of over 100 cards — with more coming in future expansions.

  • Hero-Based Deckbuilding: Choose a hero with a unique class and customize your deck with spells, creatures, weapons, and armor.

  • Online PvP: Challenge other players in real-time, ranked or casual matches.

  • No Rarities: All cards are unlocked through play or a single purchase — skill matters, not your wallet.

  • Cosmetic Progression: Unlock card backs, playmats, and visual upgrades — no gameplay advantages.

  • Tight, Strategic Design: Inspired by the best of classic TCGs, every mechanic is tuned for clarity, interaction, and counterplay.

  • Deep Fantasy World: Rich lore, handcrafted art, and interconnected factions bring the world of Broken Crowns to life.

Game Modes

  • Constructed (Classic): Bring your best deck and climb the competitive ladder.

  • Cube Draft Mode: Build a deck from a limited pool of random cards and adapt your strategy on the fly.

  • Solo Play: Face off against AI opponents to test strategies or learn the game.

Broken Crowns is made for players who want more than flash and randomness — it’s for those who love great card games and want something built to last.

This is our love letter to card games — a fresh start for those who still believe in the power of strategy, story, and skill.

Join us early. Shape the game’s future.
We're building this with the community — and your feedback will help guide every step.
